targets.rawSql: SELECT id::text AS run_id, COALESCE(project,'Unknown') AS project, status, started_at, finished_at, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at)) / 60.0, 1) AS duration_min FROM runs ORDER BY COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) DESC LIMIT 20;

options.content: Review failing runs for repeated projects to identify systemic issues. Prioritize projects with longest average durations for pipeline optimization.
